component.name: Motion
component.summary: Live wallpapers for GNOME on Wayland

description.p: Motion discovers freely reusable videos from Wikimedia Commons, preserves creator and license attribution, optimizes media for desktop playback, and applies it as a GNOME live wallpaper.
Search results are restricted to supported public-domain and Creative Commons licenses. Favorites, playlists, automatic rotation, cache limits, and resource-aware pause policies are stored locally.
Initial preview with licensed discovery, playlists, scheduling, and GNOME Shell rendering.
